search: With the established benchmarks exhausted, progress in 2027 will be read off a short list of harder measures: Humanity's Last Exam without tools, ARC-AGI-3, agentic tests such as Terminal-Bench, and independent leaderboards that run models on private question sets. The competition indicators to watch are Stanford HAI's next Arena readings in the AI Index 2027, expected in spring, and whether the open-weight gap on stricter measures such as Artificial Analysis's version 5 narrows when Chinese labs publish the weights of their newest models. The release timeline will matter less than availability: export controls have already withdrawn one model, and further restrictions would make the effective frontier differ by country.
